start_at_init.description: Whether knockd should start automatically at boot (maps to START_KNOCKD=1/0).

default_interface.description: Default network interface to use in the commented KNOCKD_OPTS line (e.g., 'eth1').

log_file.description: Path to the log file where knockd will write events.

sequence_list.description: List of port-knock sequences (each sequence defines a name, ports to knock, and action(s) to trigger).
